{{Recipe}}

'''Pasta salad''' is a cold dish consisting of cooked pasta, vegetables, and additional ingredients. This version contains chicken and egg. Ingredient quantities will depend on personal taste.

== Ingredients ==
*[[Cookbook:Carrot|Carrots]], peeled and [[Cookbook:Slicing|sliced]] thin or shredded
*[[Cookbook:Cucumber|Cucumber]]
*Rotini [[Cookbook:Pasta|pasta]], [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] and drained
*Canned [[Cookbook:Kidney Bean|kidney beans]], drained and rinsed
*Canned green [[Cookbook:Pea|peas]], drained and rinsed
*Canned sweet [[Cookbook:Corn|corn]], drained and rinsed
*Canned [[Cookbook:Baked Beans|baked beans]]
*[[Cookbook:Hard Boiled Eggs|Hard-boiled eggs]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
*Cooked [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]], cubed
*[[Cookbook:Ranch Dressing|Ranch dressing]]
*[[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|Mayonnaise]]
*[[Cookbook:Ketchup|Ketchup]]

== Procedure ==
#Peel the cucumber and cut in half. Scoop out the seeds and discard them. [[Cookbook:Dice|Dice]] the cucumber.
#Combine the cucumber and carrots. Add the drained pasta, kidney beans, peas, corn, baked beans, eggs, and chicken. [[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] to mix.
#Mix in ranch dressing, mayonnaise, and ketchup to taste.
#Allow to chill a few hours before serving.
